scripts.clean:ports: for port in 3002 3003 4001 4002; do lsof -ti :$port | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; echo 'Ports cleaned'
scripts.dev: bun run clean:ports && turbo run dev --parallel --filter=@agent-study/chat --filter=@agent-study/chat-web
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml -f infra/compose/compose.dev.yaml up -d postgres
